description: Stage 1 of the CIFAR-100 composition-level replication: the PREMISE of the norm_clip -> coord_median arm on cifar100/cifar_cnn under committed_pixel, measured before any ASR for this arm exists. No ASR here. Freezes nothing. results/admission_measurement.json and results/femnist_admission.json are read for comparison and never written.

config.server_advance: fedavg (measure_admission.measure()'s default), so every rung sees the same raw stack and the frozen CIFAR-10 baselines are comparable

tau_rule: the median client update norm measured in stage 1, so that roughly half the clients clip; instantiated on the 2-epoch pass because the clip must be a threshold on the updates stage 2 produces (Amendment 1). Frozen before the number existed and not amended by it.

premise.verdict: ARM CONFOUNDED ON THIS DATASET: THE CLIP ATTENUATES ADVERSARIES, SO Δ_c ≠ 0.

condition_1_nonzero_baseline_admission.note: Evaluated on the 1-epoch pass, the configuration in which the 0.05 floor was calibrated and in which every existing baseline in the paper was measured. A disagreement between the two passes is NOT ELIGIBLE (Amendment 1).
